recent.text: What I cannot create, I do not understand.
recent.author: Richard Feynman

recent.text: Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic.
recent.author: Arthur C. Clarke

recent.text: Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away.
recent.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

recent.text: Good design is as little design as possible.
recent.author: Dieter Rams

recent.text: Design is a plan for arranging elements in such a way as best to accomplish a particular purpose.
recent.author: Charles Eames

recent.text: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
recent.author: Steve Jobs

recent.text: The details are not the details. They make the design.
recent.author: Charles Eames

recent.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
recent.author: Alan Kay
